defect.evidence_quote: Old as_of seeds as_of_treatment; S2 derivation re-derives and may downgrade.
defect.locator_note: content_page.md treatment frontmatter and Treatment & subsequent history; lake treatment.derivation/provenance
defect.problem: The unqualified good_law treatment call as of 2026-06-30 is not safely verified from the disclosed record. The lake field says good_law, but its provenance is legacy migration/page frontmatter, the scope note says the S2 derivation may downgrade, and the treatment derivation flags audit_needed with proposed negative events and cap hits.
defect.proposed_fix: Do not publish this as unqualified good law or no negative treatment. Mark it as treatment audit required or good_law based on migration seed only, and audit the lane1/lane2 proposed negative edges before asserting current treatment as of 2026-06-30.

reasons: The lake provenance states treatment.field_i_validity came from _treatment-migration.json + page frontmatter, not a completed current treatment audit.

The disclosed derivation has lane1_negative audit_needed true with cap_hit true and proposed_negative_events 190, and lane2_top_cited audit_needed true with cap_hit true and proposed_negative_events 24.
The treatment edges include proposed negative labels including overruled, questioned, abrogated, criticized, and superseded_by_statute; those are not resolved in the disclosed record.
residual_risks: The proposed negative edges may prove false after audit, and White may still be good law; the defect is the unqualified current treatment assertion on an unaudited record.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Separate the migrated validity seed from an audited current treatment label, and remove any unqualified no-negative-treatment statement until audit completion.

reasons: The lake identity fields list court as U.S. Supreme Court and court_level/court_id as scotus.
Binding - SCOTUS is a hierarchy/weight label, and no disclosed field contradicts the court-level basis for that label.
residual_risks: The binding weight label does not cure the separate uncertainty in the good-law treatment assertion.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Render authority weight separately from treatment status so Binding - SCOTUS is not read as a current-validity guarantee.
